item.title: GTA 6 sold an estimated 19 million copies by launch morning, but there's no official number yet
item.description: Market data firm Sensor Tower puts GTA VI at about 19.1 million copies and $1.84 billion by the morning of November 19. Take-Two has not shared figures.

item.title: GTA 6 trophy list: 55 trophies, and the platinum needs 100% completion
item.description: GTA VI has 55 trophies and achievements, all single-player, worth 1,000 Gamerscore. The platinum needs 100% completion, which guides put at about 200 hours.

item.title: GTA 6 does have cheats: 61 of them, and you have to beat the story first
item.description: GTA VI's cheats are entered on the phone with a D-pad code, unlock after the main story, and turn off trophies and saving. The 11 codes two guides agree on so far.

item.title: GTA 6 on Xbox tested: Series X matches PS5, Series S runs at 720p and drops to 20 fps
item.description: Digital Foundry's Xbox results are in. Series X looks and runs much like a base PS5. Series S renders at 720p and often sits below 30 fps.

item.title: GTA 6 is out in New Zealand: what players are finding inside the game
item.description: Kiwi players got GTA VI first, at 11:00 UTC on November 18. Here's what the first hours show, from the prologue to Snapmatic, with spoilers kept behind a warning.

item.title: GTA 6 reviews are in: a 99 on Metacritic, and the complaints worth knowing
item.description: GTA VI's PS5 Metascore stood at 99 from 98 early reviews. What critics loved, what they didn't, and what Digital Foundry found about 30 fps.

item.title: GTA 6 is coming to Xbox One after all, through cloud streaming
item.description: Microsoft says Xbox One owners can stream GTA VI through Xbox Cloud Gaming from November 19 at 1am ET. You still have to buy the game.

item.title: GTA 6 preload is live: start times, 212 GB and how to make room
item.description: Digital GTA VI pre-orders can download now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and boxed copies follow on November 12. What to do before launch.

item.title: Those "leaked" GTA 6 cheat codes are GTA V's. Here's what we know
item.description: Viral posts claim GTA 6 cheat codes have leaked. The lists are GTA V's codes, and Rockstar has not confirmed any cheats for GTA VI.
